        Object.keys(boxBootstrap.infoNotices).forEach(id => {
            const rev = boxBootstrap.infoNotices[id];
            const cookieName = `infoNotice_${id}`;
            const cookieValue = Cookies.get(cookieName);

            // If the ID/Rev matches, then hide hide the specific banner.
            if (typeof cookieValue !== 'undefined' && cookieValue === rev) {
                const hideNoticeStyling = document.createTextNode(
                    `.info-notice[data-rev-id="${rev}"], .info-notice-carousel[data-rev-id="${rev}"] { display: none !important; }`,
                );
                newStyle.appendChild(hideNoticeStyling);
            }
        });
    }

    // Fallback to show the banner.
    const showNoticeStyling = document.createTextNode(
        '.info-notice.info-notice__top, .info-notice.info-notice__bottom, .info-notice-carousel { display: block; }',
    );
    newStyle.appendChild(showNoticeStyling);
    document.head.appendChild(newStyle);
};

infoNoticeInit();
</script>
<script type="text/javascript">// eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
class InfoNoticeCarouselControls {
    constructor(element) {
        if (!element) return;

        this.element = element;
        this.bannerContent = element.getElementsByClassName('info-notice-carousel-item');
        this.bannerColors = element.getElementsByClassName('info-notice-carousel-background-color');
        this.navContainer = element.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel-controls');
        this.prev = this.navContainer.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel_arrow_left');
        this.next = this.navContainer.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel_arrow_right');
        this.contentCount = this.bannerContent.length;
        this.autoplay = element.classList.contains('autoplay');
        this.autoplayer = null;
        this.pauseEvent = null;
        this.timer = element.dataset.timer ? parseInt(element.dataset.timer, 10) : 3300;
        this.active = {
            aInternal: 0,
            aListener() {},
            set v(val) {
                this.aInternal = val;
                this.aListener(val);
            },
            get v() {
                return this.aInternal;
            },
            registerListener(listener) {
                this.aListener = listener;
            },
        };

        this.setNav();
    }

    setAutoPlay() {
        const self = this;
        if (this.autoplay) {
            this.autoplayer = setInterval(() => {
                self.goNext();
            }, this.timer);
        }
    }

    debounce(func) {
        const self = this;
        clearInterval(self.autoplayer);

        return (event => {
            if (self.pauseEvent) clearTimeout(self.pauseEvent);
            self.pauseEvent = setTimeout(func, 500, event);
        })();
    }

    setNav() {
        const self = this;

        const currentTextColor = this.bannerContent[0]?.dataset?.textColor;
        this.navContainer.classList.add(currentTextColor);

        this.active.registerListener(this.updateActive.bind(this));

        this.setAutoPlay();

        // Set click listeners on arrows.
        if (this.prev && this.next) {
            this.prev.addEventListener('click', () => {
                clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
                self.goPrev();
            });
            this.next.addEventListener('click', () => {
                clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
                self.goNext();
            });
        }

        // Set pause/unpause on hover.
        this.element.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
        });
        this.element.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            self.setAutoPlay();
        });

        // Prevent autoplaying while resizing. Recalculates banner height.
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            self.debounce(self.setAutoPlay.bind(self));
        });
    }

    updateActive(val) {
        let textColor = '';

        for (let i = 0; i < this.contentCount; i += 1) {
            this.bannerContent[i].classList.remove('active');
            this.bannerColors[i].classList.remove('active');
            const currentTextColor = this.bannerContent[i].dataset.textColor;
            if (currentTextColor) {
                this.navContainer.classList.remove(currentTextColor);
            }
            if (i === val) {
                this.bannerContent[i].classList.add('active');
                this.bannerColors[i].classList.add('active');
                textColor = this.bannerContent[i].dataset.textColor;
            }
        }

        if (textColor) {
            this.navContainer.classList.add(textColor);
        }
    }

    goPrev() {
        if (this.active.v > 0) {
            this.active.v -= 1;
        } else {
            this.active.v = this.contentCount - 1;
        }
    }

    goNext() {
        if (this.active.v < this.contentCount - 1) {
            this.active.v += 1;
        } else {
            this.active.v = 0;
        }
    }
}
</script>

</style><script>
(function () {
  const TARGET   = 'Content'; // word to target in the h1 (update for translation)
  const WORDS    = ['Content', 'Contracts', 'Research', 'Campaigns', 'Data rooms', 'Reports', 'Designs', 'Presentations', 'Invoices', 'Knowledge', 'Proposals'];
  const INTERVAL = 3000;
  const DURATION = 450;
  const MIN_W    = 425;

  // Fallback gradient if the header has none we can read (matches the old snippet)
  const FALLBACK = { direction: '90deg', stops: [
    { rgb: [225, 173, 74], pos: '' },   // #E1AD4A
    { rgb: [201, 55, 228], pos: '' },   // #C937E4
  ]};

  const CLS = {
    rotator: 'hero-rotator',
    word:    'hero-rotator__word',
    suffix:  'hero-rotator__suffix',
    sizer:   'hero-rotator__sizer',
  };

  const prefersReduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const ease = (t) => (t < 0.5 ? 2 * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 2) / 2);

  // ── Gradient parsing: read the header's own gradient so the words match it ──
  const splitTop = (s) => {
    const out = []; let depth = 0, buf = '';
    for (const ch of s) {
      if (ch === '(') depth++;
      else if (ch === ')') depth--;
      if (ch === ',' && depth === 0) { out.push(buf); buf = ''; }
      else buf += ch;
    }
    if (buf.trim()) out.push(buf);
    return out;
  };
  const toRGB = (c) => {
    c = c.trim();
    let m = c.match(/rgba?\(([^)]+)\)/i);
    if (m) { const n = m[1].split(/[,\s/]+/).map(parseFloat); return [n[0] || 0, n[1] || 0, n[2] || 0]; }
    m = c.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{3,8})$/i);
    if (m) {
      let h = m[1];
      if (h.length === 3 || h.length === 4) h = h.split('').map((x) => x + x).join('');
      return [parseInt(h.slice(0, 2), 16), parseInt(h.slice(2, 4), 16), parseInt(h.slice(4, 6), 16)];
    }
    return null;
  };
  const parseGradient = (str) => {
    const m = str && str.match(/linear-gradient\((.*)\)/i);
    if (!m) return null;
    const parts = splitTop(m[1]);
    if (!parts.length) return null;
    let direction = '90deg', colorParts = parts;
    if (!/rgb|#/i.test(parts[0])) { direction = parts[0].trim(); colorParts = parts.slice(1); }
    const stops = [];
    for (const p of colorParts) {
      const cm = p.trim().match(/(rgba?\([^)]*\)|#[0-9a-f]+)\s*(.*)$/i);
      if (!cm) continue;
      const rgb = toRGB(cm[1]);
      if (rgb) stops.push({ rgb, pos: cm[2].trim() });
    }
    return stops.length >= 2 ? { direction, stops } : null;
  };

  // State
  let target, originalHTML, originalStyle, gInfo;
  let wordStops, suffixStops;
  let sizer, rotator, suffixEl;
  let current, next;
  let wordHeight, idx;
  let busy    = false;
  let running = false;
  let intervalId, resizeTimer, rafId;

  // Build a gradient from a subset of stops at a given alpha (positions dropped
  // so each segment distributes its slice evenly across its own width)
  const buildGrad = (stops, a) =>
    `linear-gradient(${gInfo.direction}, ` +
    stops.map((s) => `rgba(${s.rgb[0]},${s.rgb[1]},${s.rgb[2]},${a})`).join(', ') + ')';

  // Split the header gradient so the word gets stops 1->2 and the suffix 2->3,
  // meeting at a shared color for a seamless look. Synthesizes a midpoint for
  // two-stop gradients.
  const splitStops = () => {
    const n = gInfo.stops.length;
    if (n >= 3) {
      const mid = Math.floor(n / 2);
      wordStops   = gInfo.stops.slice(0, mid + 1);
      suffixStops = gInfo.stops.slice(mid);
    } else {
      const a = gInfo.stops[0].rgb;
      const b = gInfo.stops[n - 1].rgb;
      const midC = [0, 1, 2].map((i) => Math.round((a[i] + b[i]) / 2));
      wordStops   = [{ rgb: a }, { rgb: midC }];
      suffixStops = [{ rgb: midC }, { rgb: b }];
    }
  };

  const slide = (el, yPct) => { el.style.top = `${yPct}%`; };                  // no stacking context
  const fade  = (el, a)    => { el.style.backgroundImage = buildGrad(wordStops, a); }; // fades the actual paint

  const makeWord = (txt) => {
    const el = document.createElement('span');
    el.className = CLS.word;
    el.textContent = txt;
    return el;
  };

  const syncSizer = () => {
    const cs = window.getComputedStyle(target);
    sizer.style.fontFamily    = cs.fontFamily;
    sizer.style.fontSize      = cs.fontSize;
    sizer.style.fontWeight    = cs.fontWeight;
    sizer.style.letterSpacing = cs.letterSpacing;
  };
  const measure = (word) => { sizer.textContent = word; return sizer.offsetWidth; };

  const setup = () => {
    if (running) return;
    running = true;

    // Capture the header gradient BEFORE neutralizing, then reuse it on the leaves
    gInfo = parseGradient(window.getComputedStyle(target).backgroundImage) || FALLBACK;
    splitStops();

    // Neutralize the h1's own clip so it stops painting its gradient onto descendants
    target.style.backgroundImage       = 'none';
    target.style.webkitBackgroundClip  = 'border-box';
    target.style.backgroundClip        = 'border-box';

    sizer = document.createElement('span');
    sizer.className = CLS.sizer;
    sizer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    document.body.appendChild(sizer);

    current = makeWord(WORDS[0]);
    next    = makeWord('\u00a0');

    slide(current, 0);                        fade(current, 1);   // visible, in place
    slide(next, prefersReduced ? 0 : 100);    fade(next, 0);       // parked / invisible

    rotator = document.createElement('span');
    rotator.className = CLS.rotator;
    rotator.append(current, next);

    // Rebuild the header: rotator + static gradient suffix (e.g. " + AI")
    const suffix = target.textContent.trim().slice(TARGET.length);
    target.textContent = '';
    target.appendChild(rotator);
    if (suffix) {
      suffixEl = document.createElement('span');
      suffixEl.className = CLS.suffix;
      suffixEl.textContent = suffix;
      suffixEl.style.backgroundImage = buildGrad(suffixStops, 1);
      target.appendChild(suffixEl);
    }

    syncSizer();
    wordHeight           = current.offsetHeight;
    rotator.style.height = `${wordHeight}px`;
    rotator.style.width  = `${measure(WORDS[0])}px`;

    idx        = 0;
    intervalId = setInterval(tick, INTERVAL);
  };

  const teardown = () => {
    if (!running) return;
    running = false;
    clearInterval(intervalId);
    cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    sizer?.remove();
    sizer = null;
    target.innerHTML = originalHTML;
    if (originalStyle !== null) target.setAttribute('style', originalStyle);
    else target.removeAttribute('style');
  };

  const tick = () => {
    if (busy) return;
    busy = true;

    idx = (idx + 1) % WORDS.length;
    next.textContent = WORDS[idx];
    slide(next, prefersReduced ? 0 : 100);    // start position for incoming word
    rotator.style.width = `${measure(WORDS[idx])}px`;

    const startTime = performance.now();
    const step = (now) => {
      if (!running) return;
      const t = Math.min(1, (now - startTime) / DURATION);
      const e = ease(t);

      fade(current, 1 - e);
      fade(next, e);
      if (!prefersReduced) {
        slide(current, -100 * e);
        slide(next, 100 - 100 * e);
      }

      if (t < 1) { rafId = requestAnimationFrame(step); return; }

      // Park the outgoing word (invisible), reset its slide, swap roles
      current.textContent = '\u00a0';
      fade(current, 0);
      slide(current, prefersReduced ? 0 : 100);
      [current, next] = [next, current];
      busy = false;
    };
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };

  const onResize = () => {
    if (window.innerWidth < MIN_W) { teardown(); return; }
    if (!running) { setup(); return; }
    if (!busy) {
      syncSizer();
      wordHeight           = current.offsetHeight;
      rotator.style.height = `${wordHeight}px`;
      rotator.style.width  = `${measure(current.textContent.trim())}px`;
    }
  };

  const start = () => {
    const h1 = document.querySelector('.hero h1');
    if (!h1) return;
    const candidates = [...h1.querySelectorAll('*'), h1];
    target = candidates.find((el) => el.textContent.trim().startsWith(TARGET));
    if (!target) return;

    originalHTML  = target.innerHTML;
    originalStyle = target.getAttribute('style');

    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      if (running && window.innerWidth < MIN_W) {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
        teardown();
        return;
      }
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(onResize, 150);
    });

    if (window.innerWidth >= MIN_W) setup();
  };

  document.readyState === 'loading'
    ? document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start)
    : start();
})();
</script></article></div></div><div class="full-html-page"><div class="container"><!-- Full HTML page content start --><article class="node-page"><style>

<script type="text/javascript">function boxFormatPricing(selector) {
    const items = document.querySelectorAll(selector);

    // Using navigator.language with a fallback to 'en-US'
    const locale = navigator.language ?? 'en-US';

    items.forEach((el) => {
        const { pricingValue, pricingCurrencyCode } = el.dataset;

        if (typeof Intl !== 'undefined' && typeof Intl.NumberFormat !== 'undefined') {
            const options = {
                style: 'currency',
                currency: pricingCurrencyCode,
            };

            const fractionOptions = { ...options, minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 0 };
            const formatterOptions = { ...options, minimumFractionDigits: 2 };

            const fractionFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, fractionOptions);
            const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, formatterOptions);

            const formattedPrice = pricingValue % 1 === 0
                ? fractionFormatter.format(pricingValue)
                : formatter.format(pricingValue);

            el.innerHTML = formattedPrice;
        }
    });
}
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">const infoNoticeInit = () => {
    // Create initial styling elements.
    const newStyle = document.createElement('style');
    newStyle.type = 'text/css';
    newStyle.id = 'info-notice-style';

    // If boxBootstrap is available, check for Cookie information.
    /* eslint-disable no-undef */
    if (boxBootstrap && boxBootstrap.infoNotices) {
        Object.keys(boxBootstrap.infoNotices).forEach(id => {
            const rev = boxBootstrap.infoNotices[id];
            const cookieName = `infoNotice_${id}`;
            const cookieValue = Cookies.get(cookieName);

            // If the ID/Rev matches, then hide hide the specific banner.
            if (typeof cookieValue !== 'undefined' && cookieValue === rev) {
                const hideNoticeStyling = document.createTextNode(
                    `.info-notice[data-rev-id="${rev}"], .info-notice-carousel[data-rev-id="${rev}"] { display: none !important; }`,
                );
                newStyle.appendChild(hideNoticeStyling);
            }
        });
    }

    // Fallback to show the banner.
    const showNoticeStyling = document.createTextNode(
        '.info-notice.info-notice__top, .info-notice.info-notice__bottom, .info-notice-carousel { display: block; }',
    );
    newStyle.appendChild(showNoticeStyling);
    document.head.appendChild(newStyle);
};

infoNoticeInit();
</script>
<script type="text/javascript">// eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
class InfoNoticeCarouselControls {
    constructor(element) {
        if (!element) return;

        this.element = element;
        this.bannerContent = element.getElementsByClassName('info-notice-carousel-item');
        this.bannerColors = element.getElementsByClassName('info-notice-carousel-background-color');
        this.navContainer = element.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel-controls');
        this.prev = this.navContainer.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel_arrow_left');
        this.next = this.navContainer.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel_arrow_right');
        this.contentCount = this.bannerContent.length;
        this.autoplay = element.classList.contains('autoplay');
        this.autoplayer = null;
        this.pauseEvent = null;
        this.timer = element.dataset.timer ? parseInt(element.dataset.timer, 10) : 3300;
        this.active = {
            aInternal: 0,
            aListener() {},
            set v(val) {
                this.aInternal = val;
                this.aListener(val);
            },
            get v() {
                return this.aInternal;
            },
            registerListener(listener) {
                this.aListener = listener;
            },
        };

        this.setNav();
    }

    setAutoPlay() {
        const self = this;
        if (this.autoplay) {
            this.autoplayer = setInterval(() => {
                self.goNext();
            }, this.timer);
        }
    }

    debounce(func) {
        const self = this;
        clearInterval(self.autoplayer);

        return (event => {
            if (self.pauseEvent) clearTimeout(self.pauseEvent);
            self.pauseEvent = setTimeout(func, 500, event);
        })();
    }

    setNav() {
        const self = this;

        const currentTextColor = this.bannerContent[0]?.dataset?.textColor;
        this.navContainer.classList.add(currentTextColor);

        this.active.registerListener(this.updateActive.bind(this));

        this.setAutoPlay();

        // Set click listeners on arrows.
        if (this.prev && this.next) {
            this.prev.addEventListener('click', () => {
                clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
                self.goPrev();
            });
            this.next.addEventListener('click', () => {
                clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
                self.goNext();
            });
        }

        // Set pause/unpause on hover.
        this.element.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
        });
        this.element.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            self.setAutoPlay();
        });

        // Prevent autoplaying while resizing. Recalculates banner height.
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            self.debounce(self.setAutoPlay.bind(self));
        });
    }

    updateActive(val) {
        let textColor = '';

        for (let i = 0; i < this.contentCount; i += 1) {
            this.bannerContent[i].classList.remove('active');
            this.bannerColors[i].classList.remove('active');
            const currentTextColor = this.bannerContent[i].dataset.textColor;
            if (currentTextColor) {
                this.navContainer.classList.remove(currentTextColor);
            }
            if (i === val) {
                this.bannerContent[i].classList.add('active');
                this.bannerColors[i].classList.add('active');
                textColor = this.bannerContent[i].dataset.textColor;
            }
        }

        if (textColor) {
            this.navContainer.classList.add(textColor);
        }
    }

    goPrev() {
        if (this.active.v > 0) {
            this.active.v -= 1;
        } else {
            this.active.v = this.contentCount - 1;
        }
    }

    goNext() {
        if (this.active.v < this.contentCount - 1) {
            this.active.v += 1;
        } else {
            this.active.v = 0;
        }
    }
}
</script>

class="faq--group__items"><div class="faq--item"><button class="faq--item__header"><h5>How much data can 10GB hold?</h5></button><div class="faq--item__copy" style="display: none"><div class="faq--item__content"><p>The average user stores a mix of digital media (photos and videos) and documents. 10GB gives you the option of storing roughly:</p><ul><li>2,000 songs or pictures</li><li>More than 50,000 documents</li></ul></div></div></div><div class="faq--item"><button class="faq--item__header"><h5>Can I share my files and folders with someone who doesn’t have a Box account?</h5></button><div class="faq--item__copy" style="display: none"><div class="faq--item__content"><p>Yes! You can create an external link that can be shared with anyone, even people without a Box account. (Though while you’re at it, why not encourage them to start a free Box account?! That way you can collaborate with them and co-edit the document.)</p></div></div></div><div class="faq--item"><button class="faq--item__header"><h5>Can I buy more storage space on my plan?</h5></button><div class="faq--item__copy" style="display: none"><div class="faq--item__content"><p>If you have an Individual plan, you can free up space by deleting unused files and folders, or you can choose an upgraded plan (with unlimited storage available) that meets your needs.</p></div></div></div><div class="faq--item"><button class="faq--item__header"><h5>Can I access my Box account via mobile?</h5></button><div class="faq--item__copy" style="display: none"><div class="faq--item__content"><p>Absolutely! Download the Box Mobile App <a href="/resources/downloads">here</a> to access your content anywhere, anytime.</p></div></div></div><div class="faq--item"><button class="faq--item__header"><h5>Are there any limits on how much bandwidth our team can use?</h5></button><div class="faq--item__copy" style="display: none"><div class="faq--item__content"><p>Yes. To help prevent excessive usage by any one user, Box may limit user bandwidth if it exceeds the thresholds described below</p><ul><li>Download Bandwidth for Shared Links: Files downloaded from an open access shared link (applies to the owner of the file)
	<ul><li>10GB per user per month for Individual plans</li><li>2TB per user per month for Box Business plans</li></ul></li><li>Download/upload Ingress/Egress Bandwidth: Files uploaded and downloaded (applies to the user who uploads and/or downloads the file)
<ul><li>1TB per user per month for both Box Business and Individual plans</li></ul></li></ul><p>Learn more in our <a href="/legal/fairusepolicy">Fair Use Policy</a>.</p></div></div></div><div class="faq--item"><button class="faq--item__header"><h5>Have another question?</h5></button><div class="faq--item__copy" style="display: none"><div class="faq--item__content"><p>Check out our <a href="https://support.box.com/hc/en-us" target="_blank">help center</a>.</p><p>Need help finding the right solution? Start by <a href="/about-us/contact-us">contacting our sales team</a>. Each AI interaction — from querying content to extracting metadata — is quantified into discrete units, enabling you to forecast AI needs and optimize budgets with clarity and precision. Annual contract required. How does Box ensure the security of my data when using the APIs? Box APIs provide granular access controls and permissions to ensure robust data security. Do Box APIs support all file types? Box APIs are built to be compatible with all the file types Box handles. Click here for a full list . Where can I get support for APIs? We offer a number of different resources including Box Developer Documentation , Box Developer Community , and Box Support for account specific questions. acceptedAnswer.text: The average user stores a mix of digital media (photos and videos) and documents. 10GB gives you the option of storing roughly: 2,000 songs or pictures More than 50,000 documents

mainEntity.name: Can I share my files and folders with someone who doesn’t have a Box account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! You can create an external link that can be shared with anyone, even people without a Box account. (Though while you’re at it, why not encourage them to start a free Box account?! That way you can collaborate with them and co-edit the document.)

mainEntity.name: Can I buy more storage space on my plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you have an Individual plan, you can free up space by deleting unused files and folders, or you can choose an upgraded plan (with unlimited storage available) that meets your needs.

mainEntity.name: Can I access my Box account via mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely! Download the Box Mobile App to access your content anywhere, anytime.

 * 3. fetchInject at.js, then adobeTargetCallback().

(function initAdobeTarget(w, p) {
    if (!w.sessionStorage) {
        throw new Error('Session storage not supported');
    }

    const sixsenseConfig = w.boxSixsenseConfig;
    const { storageKey, ttlKey, apiUrl, apiToken, ttlMs } = sixsenseConfig;

    const isSixsenseCacheValid = () => {
        if (!w.localStorage) return false;
        const ttl = w.localStorage.getItem(ttlKey);
        const cached = w.localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
        return !!(ttl && cached && Number(ttl) > Date.now());
    };

    const cacheSixsenseResponse = rawJsonString => {
        if (!w.localStorage || !rawJsonString) return;
        w.localStorage.setItem(storageKey, rawJsonString);
        w.localStorage.setItem(ttlKey, (Date.now() + ttlMs).toString());
        w.storagePopulated = true;
    };

    const prefetchSixsense = () => {
        if (!w.fetch || !w.localStorage) return Promise.resolve();

        return fetch(apiUrl, {
            method: 'GET',
            headers,
            redirect: 'follow',
        })

                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});

<script type="text/javascript">const infoNoticeInit = () => {
    // Create initial styling elements.
    const newStyle = document.createElement('style');
    newStyle.type = 'text/css';
    newStyle.id = 'info-notice-style';

    // If boxBootstrap is available, check for Cookie information.
    /* eslint-disable no-undef */
    if (boxBootstrap && boxBootstrap.infoNotices) {
        Object.keys(boxBootstrap.infoNotices).forEach(id => {
            const rev = boxBootstrap.infoNotices[id];
            const cookieName = `infoNotice_${id}`;
            const cookieValue = Cookies.get(cookieName);

            // If the ID/Rev matches, then hide hide the specific banner.
            if (typeof cookieValue !== 'undefined' && cookieValue === rev) {
                const hideNoticeStyling = document.createTextNode(
                    `.info-notice[data-rev-id="${rev}"], .info-notice-carousel[data-rev-id="${rev}"] { display: none !important; }`,
                );
                newStyle.appendChild(hideNoticeStyling);
            }
        });
    }

    // Fallback to show the banner.
    const showNoticeStyling = document.createTextNode(
        '.info-notice.info-notice__top, .info-notice.info-notice__bottom, .info-notice-carousel { display: block; }',
    );
    newStyle.appendChild(showNoticeStyling);
    document.head.appendChild(newStyle);
};

infoNoticeInit();
</script>
<script type="text/javascript">// eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
class InfoNoticeCarouselControls {
    constructor(element) {
        if (!element) return;

        this.element = element;
        this.bannerContent = element.getElementsByClassName('info-notice-carousel-item');
        this.bannerColors = element.getElementsByClassName('info-notice-carousel-background-color');
        this.navContainer = element.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel-controls');
        this.prev = this.navContainer.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel_arrow_left');
        this.next = this.navContainer.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel_arrow_right');
        this.contentCount = this.bannerContent.length;
        this.autoplay = element.classList.contains('autoplay');
        this.autoplayer = null;
        this.pauseEvent = null;
        this.timer = element.dataset.timer ? parseInt(element.dataset.timer, 10) : 3300;
        this.active = {
            aInternal: 0,
            aListener() {},
            set v(val) {
                this.aInternal = val;
                this.aListener(val);
            },
            get v() {
                return this.aInternal;
            },
            registerListener(listener) {
                this.aListener = listener;
            },
        };

        this.setNav();
    }

    setAutoPlay() {
        const self = this;
        if (this.autoplay) {
            this.autoplayer = setInterval(() => {
                self.goNext();
            }, this.timer);
        }
    }

    debounce(func) {
        const self = this;
        clearInterval(self.autoplayer);

        return (event => {
            if (self.pauseEvent) clearTimeout(self.pauseEvent);
            self.pauseEvent = setTimeout(func, 500, event);
        })();
    }

    setNav() {
        const self = this;

        const currentTextColor = this.bannerContent[0]?.dataset?.textColor;
        this.navContainer.classList.add(currentTextColor);

        this.active.registerListener(this.updateActive.bind(this));

        this.setAutoPlay();

        // Set click listeners on arrows.
        if (this.prev && this.next) {
            this.prev.addEventListener('click', () => {
                clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
                self.goPrev();
            });
            this.next.addEventListener('click', () => {
                clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
                self.goNext();
            });
        }

        // Set pause/unpause on hover.
        this.element.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
        });
        this.element.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            self.setAutoPlay();
        });

        // Prevent autoplaying while resizing. Recalculates banner height.
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            self.debounce(self.setAutoPlay.bind(self));
        });
    }

    updateActive(val) {
        let textColor = '';

        for (let i = 0; i < this.contentCount; i += 1) {
            this.bannerContent[i].classList.remove('active');
            this.bannerColors[i].classList.remove('active');
            const currentTextColor = this.bannerContent[i].dataset.textColor;
            if (currentTextColor) {
                this.navContainer.classList.remove(currentTextColor);
            }
            if (i === val) {
                this.bannerContent[i].classList.add('active');
                this.bannerColors[i].classList.add('active');
                textColor = this.bannerContent[i].dataset.textColor;
            }
        }

        if (textColor) {
            this.navContainer.classList.add(textColor);
        }
    }

    goPrev() {
        if (this.active.v > 0) {
            this.active.v -= 1;
        } else {
            this.active.v = this.contentCount - 1;
        }
    }

    goNext() {
        if (this.active.v < this.contentCount - 1) {
            this.active.v += 1;
        } else {
            this.active.v = 0;
        }
    }
}
</script>

 * 1. fetchInject at_callback, then fetchInject [visitor_api, visitor_api_init].
 * 2. initVisitorId() — Visitor + targetPageParams / Launch.
 * 3. fetchInject at.js, then adobeTargetCallback().
 */

(function initAdobeTarget(w, p) {
    if (!w.sessionStorage) {
        throw new Error('Session storage not supported');
    }

    const sixsenseConfig = w.boxSixsenseConfig;
    const { storageKey, ttlKey, apiUrl, apiToken, ttlMs } = sixsenseConfig;

    const isSixsenseCacheValid = () => {
        if (!w.localStorage) return false;
        const ttl = w.localStorage.getItem(ttlKey);
        const cached = w.localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
        return !!(ttl && cached && Number(ttl) > Date.now());
    };

    const cacheSixsenseResponse = rawJsonString => {
        if (!w.localStorage || !rawJsonString) return;
        w.localStorage.setItem(storageKey, rawJsonString);
        w.localStorage.setItem(ttlKey, (Date.now() + ttlMs).toString());
        w.storagePopulated = true;
    };

    const prefetchSixsense = () => {
        if (!w.fetch || !w.localStorage) return Promise.resolve();
        if (isSixsenseCacheValid()) return Promise.resolve();

        const headers = new Headers();
        headers.append('Authorization', `Token ${apiToken}`);

        return fetch(apiUrl, {
            method: 'GET',
            headers,
            redirect: 'follow',
        })
            .then(resp => {
                if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Sixsense API HTTP ${resp.status}`);
                return resp.text();
            })
            .then(raw => {
                if (raw) {
                    cacheSixsenseResponse(raw);
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
    };

    if (w.fetch) {
        prefetchSixsense();

        fetchInject(
            [p.at_callback],
            fetchInject([p.visitor_api, p.visitor_api_init]).then(() => {
                initVisitorId();

                    adobeTargetCallback();
                });
            }),

    }

      // So long we split.

        return seed.slice(seed.length - reqWidth);
      }

      // So short we pad.
      if (reqWidth > seed.length) {

<script type="text/javascript">const infoNoticeInit = () => {
    // Create initial styling elements.
    const newStyle = document.createElement('style');
    newStyle.type = 'text/css';
    newStyle.id = 'info-notice-style';

    // If boxBootstrap is available, check for Cookie information.
    /* eslint-disable no-undef */
    if (boxBootstrap && boxBootstrap.infoNotices) {
        Object.keys(boxBootstrap.infoNotices).forEach(id => {
            const rev = boxBootstrap.infoNotices[id];
            const cookieName = `infoNotice_${id}`;
            const cookieValue = Cookies.get(cookieName);

            // If the ID/Rev matches, then hide hide the specific banner.
            if (typeof cookieValue !== 'undefined' && cookieValue === rev) {
                const hideNoticeStyling = document.createTextNode(
                    `.info-notice[data-rev-id="${rev}"], .info-notice-carousel[data-rev-id="${rev}"] { display: none !important; }`,
                );
                newStyle.appendChild(hideNoticeStyling);
            }
        });
    }

    // Fallback to show the banner.
    const showNoticeStyling = document.createTextNode(
        '.info-notice.info-notice__top, .info-notice.info-notice__bottom, .info-notice-carousel { display: block; }',
    );
    newStyle.appendChild(showNoticeStyling);
    document.head.appendChild(newStyle);
};

infoNoticeInit();
</script>
<script type="text/javascript">// eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
class InfoNoticeCarouselControls {
    constructor(element) {
        if (!element) return;

        this.element = element;
        this.bannerContent = element.getElementsByClassName('info-notice-carousel-item');
        this.bannerColors = element.getElementsByClassName('info-notice-carousel-background-color');
        this.navContainer = element.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel-controls');
        this.prev = this.navContainer.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel_arrow_left');
        this.next = this.navContainer.querySelector('.info-notice-carousel_arrow_right');
        this.contentCount = this.bannerContent.length;
        this.autoplay = element.classList.contains('autoplay');
        this.autoplayer = null;
        this.pauseEvent = null;
        this.timer = element.dataset.timer ? parseInt(element.dataset.timer, 10) : 3300;
        this.active = {
            aInternal: 0,
            aListener() {},
            set v(val) {
                this.aInternal = val;
                this.aListener(val);
            },
            get v() {
                return this.aInternal;
            },
            registerListener(listener) {
                this.aListener = listener;
            },
        };

        this.setNav();
    }

    setAutoPlay() {
        const self = this;
        if (this.autoplay) {
            this.autoplayer = setInterval(() => {
                self.goNext();
            }, this.timer);
        }
    }

    debounce(func) {
        const self = this;
        clearInterval(self.autoplayer);

        return (event => {
            if (self.pauseEvent) clearTimeout(self.pauseEvent);
            self.pauseEvent = setTimeout(func, 500, event);
        })();
    }

    setNav() {
        const self = this;

        const currentTextColor = this.bannerContent[0]?.dataset?.textColor;
        this.navContainer.classList.add(currentTextColor);

        this.active.registerListener(this.updateActive.bind(this));

        this.setAutoPlay();

        // Set click listeners on arrows.
        if (this.prev && this.next) {
            this.prev.addEventListener('click', () => {
                clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
                self.goPrev();
            });
            this.next.addEventListener('click', () => {
                clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
                self.goNext();
            });
        }

        // Set pause/unpause on hover.
        this.element.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            clearInterval(self.autoplayer);
        });
        this.element.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            self.setAutoPlay();
        });

        // Prevent autoplaying while resizing. Recalculates banner height.
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            self.debounce(self.setAutoPlay.bind(self));
        });
    }

    updateActive(val) {
        let textColor = '';

        for (let i = 0; i < this.contentCount; i += 1) {
            this.bannerContent[i].classList.remove('active');
            this.bannerColors[i].classList.remove('active');
            const currentTextColor = this.bannerContent[i].dataset.textColor;
            if (currentTextColor) {
                this.navContainer.classList.remove(currentTextColor);
            }
            if (i === val) {
                this.bannerContent[i].classList.add('active');
                this.bannerColors[i].classList.add('active');
                textColor = this.bannerContent[i].dataset.textColor;
            }
        }

        if (textColor) {
            this.navContainer.classList.add(textColor);
        }
    }

    goPrev() {
        if (this.active.v > 0) {
            this.active.v -= 1;
        } else {
            this.active.v = this.contentCount - 1;
        }
    }

    goNext() {
        if (this.active.v < this.contentCount - 1) {
            this.active.v += 1;
        } else {
            this.active.v = 0;
        }
    }
}
</script>

      </label></h4><div class="accordionator__copy" id="slide-315121-1-content"><div class="accordionator__wysiwyg"><p class="large-type">The Box Agent uses state-of-the-art foundational models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more to understand, reason, and generate. </p></div><div class="accordionator__buttons " ></div></div></div></article><article class="accordionator__slide" data-id="2"><div class="accordionator__slide-container"><h4><label for="tab-315121-2" role="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="slide-315121-2-content" class="accordionator__label">
        Built for a specific goal
      </label></h4><div class="accordionator__copy" id="slide-315121-2-content"><div class="accordionator__wysiwyg"><p class="large-type">The Box Agent is designed for executing on a clear objective, like summarizing a document or identifying legal risk.       </label></h4><div class="accordionator__copy" id="slide-315121-3-content"><div class="accordionator__wysiwyg"><p class="large-type">The Box Agent uses natural language to reason, create multi-step plans, and complete complex work.       </label></h4><div class="accordionator__copy" id="slide-315121-4-content"><div class="accordionator__wysiwyg"><p class="large-type">Apply advanced skills like summarization, Q&A, and content drafting directly within your workflow. Register now News Pricing Contact Log in Get started Box AI Agents Put your unstructured data to work with AI Explore now Meet our newest agent Powering the world's most innovative organizations. See customers Secure AI agents grounded in your bespoke business context Enterprise AI requires agents that are secure and connected to business context. Built on the Box platform, Box AI Agents unite the reasoning power of frontier models with your proprietary content. By respecting strict enterprise permissions, they safely automate mission-critical tasks and put your content to work. Get to know each agent, starting with the Box Agent — your home base for reimagining work with AI.     Introducing the new Box Agent Improve search efficiency Get contextual answers and actionable insights. Box Agent pulls key facts, dates, and documents across content types while respecting user permissions.  Conduct deep research quickly Speed up time-to-insights with AI-driven analyses across large volumes of content. Automatically surface key trends and connections and confidently know every query is backed by enterprise-grade security, compliance, and governance. Ask questions with ease Skip tedious document reviews. The Box Agent lets you chat directly with your content, SOWs, leases, or thousands of files. Instantly ask questions, summarize terms, compare clauses, and surface risks with the Box Agent powered by OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google within Box. Automate content creation Quickly create marketing copy, product briefs, RFP responses, and research proposals. Generate accurate, context-aware content, grounded in your files, without switching tools. Anatomy of the Box Agent Powered by the latest models  The Box Agent uses state-of-the-art foundational models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more to understand, reason, and generate.  Built for a specific goal The Box Agent is designed for executing on a clear objective, like summarizing a document or identifying legal risk. That way you can ensure you’re accomplishing your goal through targeted output that’s actionable, and relevant to your business. Follows a thoughtful plan The Box Agent uses natural language to reason, create multi-step plans, and complete complex work. By leveraging implicit multi-agent orchestration, a single prompt strings together finding files, analyzing data, and creating new deliverables. Uses capabilities and tools to take action Apply advanced skills like summarization, Q&A, and content drafting directly within your workflow. The Agent chains together native tools to transform unstructured data into final outcomes, like executive summaries or presentations. Knows your content securely Built natively on the Box content layer, the Agent operates with permissions-aware retrieval to ensure outputs are based only on content a user is authorized to access. It inherently maintains all existing security permissions, retention rules, and compliance controls on your content.     Purpose-built agents for key workflows Smarter security alerts, faster response The AI Threat Analysis Agent transforms complex security alerts into clear, actionable summaries. It analyzes threat context, explains potential risks, and helps security teams triage faster—reducing manual investigation and enabling quicker decisions to protect your organization's content. Context-aware content classification, automated The AI Classification Agent uses intelligent context analysis to automatically classify content based on sensitivity—not just keywords. Define your own classification criteria, and let AI apply labels at scale. Accelerate content protection while reducing administrative overhead across your organization. Extract key information from your content The Box AI Extract Agent instantly surfaces key details from contracts, forms, and images directly in Box Preview and Box Apps. Define custom fields and extraction logic to turn unstructured data into structured metadata. Quickly extract key facts, figures and themes from large volumes of content. Customize your Box AI Agents Choose from leading models Empower your business with LLM choice by selecting the best foundational model—such as Gemini, ChatGPT, or Claude—for every task. Box AI provides the flexibility to future-proof your strategy and optimize performance across diverse use cases without vendor lock-in Add knowledge Ground AI in the content that runs your business. Using Box AI Studio , administrators can outfit custom agents with unique instructions and scoped knowledge, like specific files or Box Hubs, to ensure every output is contextually accurate and tailored to your specific workflows. Test your AI Agent Experiment and refine with precision in Box AI Studio . Tweak instructions, swap models, and test your custom agents against real enterprise context to discover the optimal configuration for your unique business needs before deploying at scale. Stay secure with access controls The Box Agent is secure by design, maintaining existing user permissions, retention rules, and compliance controls on your content by default. Admins maintain granular authority through Box AI Studio, ensuring that agents only access authorized content and that data is never used to train external models. (Coming soon) Define agent guardrails Set rule-based controls from the Admin Console to define operational boundaries for every Box custom agent. Block external sharing, prevent bulk deletion, restrict access by content classification, and configure end-user override options. No coding required. One context layer. Every AI tool.   Box connects the AI tools your teams rely on to your enterprise content through the Box MCP server, native connectors, or direct integrations. Every response traces back to the source, so your teams always know where the answer came from.   See how Read more Automate complex RFP responses Draft high-quality responses by autonomously searching compliance guides and whitepapers to answer 50-page RFPs in minutes. Review contracts against policy Act as a first-pass legal review by identifying deviations between vendor MSAs and your company’s standard terms playbooks. Generate personalized onboarding Synthesize role-specific handbooks and roadmaps into a structured 30-day schedule for new hires automatically. Architect multi-channel campaigns Research competitive trends and then draft interconnected blog posts, social updates, and email sequences in one cohesive session. Draft technical product manuals Generate deep-dive technical documentation from sparse engineering notes, ensuring every nuanced requirement is captured and cross-referenced. Perform deep-dive regulatory audits Analyze massive policy documents against external state laws to produce a granular gap analysis report with specific remediation steps. Run a global RFP production desk Enable a high-volume sales team to generate dozens of deep-dive, bespoke bid responses every day. Scale real-time asset transcreation Instantly adapt and rewrite complex marketing assets for 20+ global regions simultaneously, maintaining brand voice and cultural nuance Automate continuous compliance ops Perform a deep reasoning audit on every single contract or financial report uploaded across the global organization in real-time. See how customers fuel workflows with the Box Agent Box AI’s Extract Agents transform how Fundwell derives insights from content. Pulling key financial data from statements, tax forms, and investment documents now happens in minutes.    See webinar A travel company saved 800+ hours of manually processing itineraries by leveraging custom Al Extract Agents. See webinar USAA delivers a smooth onboarding experience. Teams securely manage confidential information, leveraging AI for workflow automation and  real-time e-signatures. Read story 1 2 3 Previous "> Next NOW AVAILABLE Enterprise Advanced Intelligent content workflows and secure document management Buy now Contact us Multi-step execution with extended context limits Tackle complex RFPs and create ready to share communications with Box Agent in Pro Mode Create custom AI agents for specific business needs Connected forms for business processes with Box Forms Automated document generation* Agentic metadata extraction* Higher API allowances Large file uploads up to 500GB Compliant long-term data preservation with Box Archive Agentic workflows All Enterprise Plus capabilities included * via AI Agents. Learn More Here FAQ General & Capabilities What is a Box AI Agent and how is it different from a basic chatbot? Unlike generic chatbots, Box AI Agents are grounded in your enterprise content. They don't just "chat"; they securely search, synthesize, and create new content — like RFPs or project plans — using the specific files you have stored in Box. Can Box AI Agents search across my entire company's content? Yes. Through the AI Home experience, you can ask questions or generate content by securely querying all files you have permission to access across your entire Box instance, not just a single folder. Is my data used to train global AI models? No. At Box, we maintain a strict "your data is your data" policy. Your content is never used to train third-party models. Pro Mode & Reasoning What is "Pro Mode" and when should I use it? Pro Mode is a toggle for tasks requiring deep reasoning. It gives the Agent more "thinking time" to handle complex, multi-step problems—like drafting a technical manual or auditing a contract—and increases the output length significantly.   Tiers & Access Which Box plan includes Box Agents? The default Box Agent is available in our Enterprise Plus (E+) tier. The advanced capabilities, including the Pro Mode toggle, are exclusive to our Enterprise Advanced (EAdv) offering.   YouTube Blog Twitter Facebook Company Use Cases Service & Support Resources International sites About Us Leadership ESG Press Box Blog Investor Relations Box.org Careers Partners Legal Box AI AI Agents Collaboration Cloud Storage Mobility Security Box for ECM File Sharing Document Management File Transfer Cloud Backup Virtual Data Room Cloud Content Management Send Large Files Fast Product Support Training Community Contact Us 1.877.729.4269 Trust Center Box AI Trust GDPR Compliance GxP Validation Demos Downloads Resource Library United States (English) United Kingdom (English) India (English) Netherlands (English) Sweden (English) Australia (English) Canada (English) Singapore (English) France (Français) Deutschland (Deutsch) Italia (Italiano) 日本 (日本語) 한국 (한국어) América Latina (Español) Home Careers Partners Events Pricing Downloads Resources Service & Support Training Tech Support Contact Us Blogs Community Developers ©2026 Box Sitemap Subscriptions Terms of Service Privacy Policy Do Not Sell My Info Cookie Notification English (US) English (UK/Europe) English (Canada) English (Australia) English (India) English (Netherlands) English (Sweden) English (Singapore) Français Deutsch Italiano 日本語 한국어 Spanish
